rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.002, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-5 REGULARIZATION lever (efficiency pivot). Iterations 200->400->800->1000 lifted hr 0.16648->0.21783->0.26347->0.27630 but the per-step gain is shrinking (data term converging; gains now from continued TV smoothing) and runtime nears the wall. Reach a smoother optimum PER STEP via stronger TV. ONE knob: tv_lambda 0.001->0.002 (2x), iterations kept 1000, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, gd, fbp. HYPOTHESIS: stronger TV reaches a more-smoothed optimum in the same 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.27630; if it over-smooths (fine breast structure lost, hr drops) the lambda=1e-3 optimum was near-best and I bisect toward 1.5e-3. Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
